g.text: Worker ≠ job ≠ commuter flow ≠ population. Commuting ≠ migration. Municipal boundary ≠ utility territory. Dependence ≠ vulnerability. Hazard interface ≠ exposure, dose, or illness. No composite score, protected-class ranking, or individual movement model.
